facts.text: The K-State Land Grant Promise covers the equivalent cost of tuition up to 15 credit hours per semester for Pell-eligible Kansas undergraduates from families earning $80,000 or less.

sources.title: Land Grant Promise | K-State | Kansas State University
sources.quote: assures that full-time, Pell-eligible undergraduates with total household income of $80,000 or less will receive a total grant and/or scholarship aid package up to the equivalent cost of 15 credit hours of tuition
